Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full work-order payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Work order WO-4821","orderNumber":"WO-4821","product":"Trailblazer Assembly Cell · 2 units","priority":"high","etaText":"Est. ship Oct 2","updatedText":"Updated 1h ago","milestones":[{"label":"Order received","state":"done","timeText":"Sep 18","owner":"Intake"},{"label":"Machining","state":"done","timeText":"Sep 22","owner":"Cell A"},{"label":"Assembly","state":"current","timeText":"In progress","owner":"Bay 4"},{"label":"Quality check","state":"todo"},{"label":"Ready to ship","state":"todo"}],"submitText":"Message production team","submitValue":"I have a question about work order WO-4821"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading. Defaults to 'Work order <orderNumber>' when omitted.
- 'orderNumber' (string, optional): the work-order id.
- 'product' (string, optional): one line describing what is being built.
- 'priority' (string, optional): one of 'low','normal','high','urgent'. Shown as a colored chip; omit to hide it.
- 'etaText' (string, optional): estimated ship/completion, e.g. 'Est. ship Oct 2'.
- 'updatedText' (string, optional): freshness stamp, e.g. 'Updated 1h ago'.
- 'milestones' (array, REQUIRED, 2 to 7 objects, in order top to bottom): each has 'label' (string, REQUIRED) and 'state' (one of 'done','current','todo'); optional 'timeText' (string) and 'owner' (string), joined into a meta line. Mark exactly one as 'current' (the stage in progress); earlier stages 'done', later ones 'todo'.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): action-button label, e.g. 'Message production team'. Omit to hide it.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): the exact message sent back when tapped; defaults to 'submitText'.

Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
